title: Audi Warranty Administrator
description:
About the role

Sytner Group currently has an opening for a highly motivated Warranty Administrator to join our prestigious dealership at Huddersfield Audi.

As a Sytner Warranty Administrator, you will be responsible for costing and invoicing all warranty jobs. You will ensure the accurate submissions of warranty and goodwill claims on a daily basis and ensure recalls are administered and warranty debt is controlled. You will also ensure manufacturer standards are adhered to at all times.

Sytner Warranty Administrators work a variety of flexible patterns which can typically include weekends to ensure we provide our customers with the highest possible levels of service.

About you

Previous experience in an administrative capacity is essential. Knowledge of the motor industry and the Kerridge system would also be advantageous; however, this is not crucial for the right candidate.

Ideally, you will have excellent organisational skills and be able to handle conflicting demands whilst able to identify priorities in a highly demanding environment.

Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to develop strong, cooperative relationships with customers & colleagues are also a must.

Why Sytner?

Sytner Group are delighted to provide an industry-leading benefits package.

We are passionate about continuous improvement and building an environment where everyone feels valued, appreciated and able to reach their full potential.
- Enhanced Holiday Entitlement 33 days inc. bank holidays
- Industry-leading Maternity, Paternity and Adoption Pay
- Career Development
- Recognition of Long Service every 5 years
- Discounted Car Schemes
- High Street Discounts
- Discounted Gym memberships
- Cycle to work scheme
- One day a year paid voluntary / community work

At Sytner, our values and the way we behave are important to us. We are committed to creating an equitable working environment where we value and respect every individual's unique contribution, supporting our colleagues to thrive and achieve their full potential.

As part of our commitment to Diversity and Inclusion, you have the right to ask for changes / adjustments to job interviews and the recruitment process. For more information around reasonable adjustments and the recruitment process please click here.

Unsure? Read on

We represent over 23 of the world's most prestige vehicle brands, across our 140 UK dealerships.

We pride ourselves on Developing Talent and Building Careers and our colleagues recently scored Sytner Group an outstanding 89% on our colleague engagement survey.

title: Internal Sales Executive
description:
Internal Sales Executive

Location: Huddersfield, West Yorkshire (Office-Based)
Salary: 35,000 Basic + Bonus
Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:30am - 5:00pm

An Exciting Opportunity in a Specialist Industry

Are you a confident, commercially minded sales professional who enjoys building relationships, delivering excellent customer service and turning enquiries into sales?

This company is looking for an enthusiastic Internal Sales Executive to join its team in Huddersfield.

Specialising in the supply of industrial door and loading bay parts to the trade, this company supports engineers, installers and service companies with the components they need to keep equipment operating safely and efficiently.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with a background in internal sales, technical parts or B2 B customer service to join a specialist business where product knowledge, customer relationships and a proactive sales approach are key to success.

Experience within the industrial door industry would be a real advantage, but we're equally interested in candidates from other technical sales or parts backgrounds.

The Role

As an Internal Sales Executive, you'll be a key point of contact for trade customers, helping them source the right products while maximising sales opportunities and delivering an outstanding level of service.

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:
- Handling incoming sales enquiries via telephone and email from engineers, installers and trade customers.
- Proactively following up quotations, developing customer relationships and converting enquiries into orders.
- Identifying the correct industrial door and loading bay components, offering suitable alternatives where appropriate.
- Preparing accurate, competitive quotations and processing customer orders.
- Working closely with purchasing, warehouse and logistics teams to ensure orders are fulfilled efficiently.
- Providing customers with product availability, pricing and delivery information.
- Identifying opportunities to increase sales from existing customers and develop repeat business.
- Resolving customer queries and maintaining accurate records using internal CRM and order management systems.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is proactive, organised and confident speaking with customers, with the commercial awareness to spot opportunities and turn conversations into sales.

Ideally, you'll have:
- Previous experience in internal sales, B2 B sales, trade counter sales or a technical parts environment.
- Excellent telephone communication skills and a confident, customer-focused approach.
- A proactive sales mentality with the ability to follow up opportunities and close orders.
- Strong attention to detail when dealing with product specifications, quotations and part numbers.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple enquiries in a busy environment.
- Comfortable using Microsoft Office, CRM systems or order processing software.

Industry knowledge would be particularly desirable, especially experience with products such as:
- Industrial roller shutters and sectional overhead doors.
- High-speed and fast-action doors.
- Dock levellers and loading bay equipment.
- Door motors, control panels and automation components.
- Safety edges, seals, sensors and associated spare parts.

However, candidates with experience selling engineering components, electrical parts, mechanical spares or other technical products are also encouraged to apply.

What's On Offer?
- 35,000 basic salary plus bonus.
- Monday to Friday working hours - no weekends.
- Permanent, office-based position in Huddersfield.
- Specialist product training and ongoing support.
- Opportunity to develop your technical knowledge and sales expertise.
- A varied role combining customer service, relationship management and commercial sales.

Interested?

If you're an experienced Internal Sales Executive, Parts Advisor or technically minded sales professional looking for your next opportunity, we'd love to hear from you.

Please note, if your application is suitable, one of our consultants will call you within 5 working days. If you have not heard from us within this time, your application has unfortunately been unsuccessful, however we will keep your details on our talent management system to consider you for future opportunities.

title: Markets Customer Service Assistant
company: Lynx Employment Services Ltd - Agency - Temporary
description:
Our client is looking for a Customer Service Assistant for their Markets Service. This is a frontline operational role supporting the day-to-day running of Markets across Huddersfield, Dewsbury and other market locations as required.

The role operates on a flexible rota basis, covering trading days, weekends, public holidays and occasional early starts or later finishes to meet business needs. The Markets operate throughout the year and flexibility is essential.

Duties include:
- Opening, securing and closing market facilities
- Setting up and dismantling market stalls and equipment
- Supporting traders, customers and visitors with excellent customer service
- Maintaining high standards of cleanliness and presentation across market sites
- Undertaking basic maintenance and operational checks
- Supporting health and safety arrangements and site inspections
- Driving a vehicle and transporting equipment between sites where required
- Supporting specialist markets, events and community activities
- Assisting Duty Managers with the safe and efficient operation of market service

The role is physically active and involves regular manual handling, outdoor working and travel between locations. The successful candidate must be reliable, flexible, customer-focused and able to work both independently and as part of a team.

A full UK driving licence is essential

Working Pattern

37 hours per week (or equivalent agency cover requirement) 7-day rota. Weekend and Bank Holiday working required Flexibility to work across multiple market sites and events

Job Focus Sheet Summary The post holder will provide operational support across the Markets Service, ensuring markets are safe, clean, welcoming and ready for trade, while supporting traders, customers, events and the ongoing operation of temporary market facilities during the redevelopment of Huddersfield and Dewsbury Markets.

title: Material Verification & Document Controller
description:
Location: Huddersfield

Salary: 35,000 per annum

Permanent

We are currently recruiting for a Material Verification & Document Controller to join an established engineering organisation operating within a highly regulated manufacturing environment.

Working as part of the Quality and Metallurgy function, you will be responsible for ensuring incoming materials and components meet the required technical specifications, certification and quality standards.

The Role
- Review and verify material certificates and test documentation against engineering specifications.
- Ensure materials meet relevant quality standards and traceability requirements.
- Raise and manage NCRs for non-conforming materials.
- Maintain accurate inspection, certification and quality records.
- Liaise with Quality, Engineering, Procurement, Supply Chain and suppliers.
- Support activities relating to material testing, heat treatment and verification.

The Ideal Candidate
- Experience within quality inspection, materials or engineering/manufacturing.
- Familiar with material certificates and technical documentation.
- Knowledge of NCRs, traceability and ISO 9001.
- Strong attention to detail with good communication and organisational skills.
- Experience with SAP, metallurgy, heat treatment, NDT or material testing would be advantageous.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a Quality Inspection or Materials background who wants to develop their technical knowledge further within materials, metallurgy and quality assurance.

Due to the nature of the position, all candidates must meet Right to Work in the UK criteria and achieve the required security and clearance requirements to undertake this role.
